premises: Rapid quenching preserves a high degree of short-range chemical order (SRO) in Al–Co–Cr–Fe–Ni alloys.
This quenched-in SRO kinetically hinders diffusion-driven formation of intermetallic or sigma phases.
Suppressing secondary phases maintains a single-phase solid solution.
A single-phase solid solution is crucial for combined high-temperature strength, cryogenic toughness, environmental resistance, and radiation tolerance.
Slow cooling permits sufficient atomic diffusion for secondary phase precipitation.
